name: edge-strategy-reviewer
description: > Critically review strategy drafts from edge-strategy-designer for edge plausibility, overfitting risk, sample size adequacy, and execution realism. Use when strategy_drafts/*.yaml exists and needs quality gate before pipeline export. Outputs PASS/REVISE/REJECT verdicts with confidence scores.
author: tradermonty
summary_zh: 一款交易策略草案质检工具，用于导出前评估优势可信度、过拟合风险、样本量和执行可行性，并给出审核结论。
